description: This file defines a class 'ActivitiesViewList' that extends 'ViewList' and overrides the 'display' method to set module language strings and include a calendar module.

classes.name: ActivitiesViewList
classes.description: A class for handling the 'list' view of activities in the SuiteCRM application, extending the base 'ViewList' class.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Sets the calendar module language strings and includes the calendar index file, used to render the list view.
